# `wb-` Prefix Audit

**Generated by:** `node scripts/audit-wb-prefix.mjs` (re-run it; do not trust these numbers by hand)
**Measured at:** 4.0.0, after component removal
**Scope:** every tracked file, excluding `node_modules/`, `out/`, `.claude/`, build output

## TL;DR

There are **48,768** `wb-` strings. They are not one thing, and "remove all of them" is
four different jobs with four different costs. One of the four is a live defect and should
be fixed now. One of them is the project's own name and should never be removed.

| Category | Hits | Distinct | Files | Verdict |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| **TAG** — `<article>` | 1,166 | 167 | 131 | **Defect. Remove all.** |
| **CLASS** — `.x-card__header` | 35,134 | 1,320 | 1,934 | Deliberate. Separate decision. |
| **MODULE** — `src/wb-viewmodels/` | 5,484 | 7 | 1,331 | Internal. Low value, high churn. |
| **PACKAGE** — `wb-starter` | 5,103 | 2 | 385 | **Keep.** It is the product's name. |
| **DATA** — `data-x-ready` | 1,881 | 39 | 71 | Internal runtime state. Keep, or move with CLASS. |

## 1. TAG — 1,166 dead component tags (fix now)

Components were removed in 4.0.0. A hyphenated tag with no registration is an
`HTMLUnknownElement`: it parses, renders inline and unstyled, attaches no behavior, and
**throws no error**. That silence is the whole problem — these do not announce themselves,
which is why 1,166 survived a migration meant to remove them.

| Area | Hits | Files | Why it matters |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `scripts/` | 321 | 22 | **Generators.** They re-emit the tags on every run. |
| `src/` | 356 | 77 | 201 of 202 JS hits are comments. `src/core/mvvm-test.html` is live. |
| `templates/` | 274 | 16 | Scaffolding. Teaches the dead vocabulary to every new project. |
| `data/` | 120 | 8 | Generated artifacts. Fix the producer, not the file. |
| `project-index.html` | 68 | 1 | Live page. |
| `.vscode/` | 9 | 1 | `html-custom-data.json` — editor autocomplete still offers them. |
| `tests/`, `articles/`, `server.js` | 17 | 5 | |

Top offenders: `<div x-demo>` (268 with closers), `<article>` (169), `<button>` (125),
`<div>` (66).

### The generator trap

`scripts/generate-behaviors-page.js` alone holds 159. `scripts/generate-demos-list.mjs`
holds 54. **Fixing generated output without fixing the generator is not a fix** — the next
run puts every tag back. This already happened in this release: `demos/site/*.html` was
migrated, `scripts/generate-site.mjs` was not, and the tags returned on the next regen.

Order of operations is therefore fixed: **generator → regenerate → verify output.** Never
edit generated files directly.

### Why `.vscode/html-custom-data.json` is worse than it looks

Nine hits, but they are autocomplete entries. The editor actively *suggests*
`<div x-container>`, `<div x-grid>` and `<div>` to anyone typing in this repo. It is the one
file that manufactures new occurrences faster than they can be removed.

## 2. CLASS — 35,134 (do not touch yet)

The styling system: `x-card`, `x-demo`, `x-button`, `x-btn`, plus BEM
(`x-demo__code`, `x-alert--warning`). 1,320 distinct tokens across 1,934 files.

`docs/architecture/proposals/remove-wb-prefix-authoring-surface.md` already decided this:
*"Does not touch internal CSS class naming."* That decision looks right. The prefix is
invisible to authors — nobody types `x-card`, the behavior injects it — so renaming buys
no author-facing clarity for a change touching more than half the repo's files.

**If it is done anyway, it is a mechanical rename with one specific hazard**, already hit
once in this release: a blanket replace over every string literal turned
`classList.add('x-card')` into `classList.add('.x-card')` across **203 sites in 27
files**, because a class name and a selector are textually identical and differ only by
call context. Any such pass must be context-aware (`classList.*`, `className`,
`setAttribute('class')`, `createElement`, `tagName`) and must leave real selectors
(`querySelector`, `rule.selectorText`) alone.

## 3. MODULE — 5,484 (not worth it alone)

Directory and file names: `wb-viewmodels` (2,844), `wb-models` (1,105), `wb-lazy` (633),
`wb-views` (613), `wb-parts`, `wb-tests`, `wb-bootstrap`.

Renaming directories rewrites every import for zero behavior change and guarantees a
painful merge against any open branch. Two notes:

- **`wb-views` still appears 613 times** even though the system was deleted in 4.0.0. Those
  reference something that no longer exists — worth a sweep regardless of any rename.
- If `src/` is ever restructured for another reason, fold the rename into that. Not before.

## 4. PACKAGE — 5,103 (keep)

`wb-starter` and `create-wb-starter`: the npm name, the GitHub repo, the git dependency
Ultrasonic pins, every doc heading, every install line. Removing this is renaming the
product. It is not in the same conversation as the other categories.

## 5. DATA — 1,881 (keep, or move with CLASS)

`data-x-categorized` (563), `data-x-sources` (397), `data-x-prefixed` (373),
`data-x-ready` (116). Internal runtime state the framework writes and reads — not an
authoring surface. If CLASS is ever renamed these go with it; alone they are churn.

---

## Plan

Each phase is independently shippable and gated. Nothing here needs a big-bang branch.

### Phase 1 — Stop the bleeding (small, do first)

1. `.vscode/html-custom-data.json` — remove the dead tag entries. Until this goes, the
   editor keeps producing new ones.
2. Wire `scripts/audit-wb-prefix.mjs` into the compliance project. It already exits
   non-zero when `TAG > 0`, so it fails the build the moment a component tag returns. Land
   it *tolerating* the current 1,166, then ratchet the threshold down each phase.

**Gate:** the audit runs in CI and the count cannot grow.

### Phase 2 — Generators (321 hits, 22 files)

Fix `scripts/generate-behaviors-page.js` (159), `scripts/generate-demos-list.mjs` (54) and
the rest, then regenerate and diff. Same fix already applied to `scripts/generate-site.mjs`:
emit a neutral host carrying `x-<behavior>`, or the semantic element where one exists.

**Gate:** regenerate twice; the second run produces no diff, and TAG drops by the generated
total.

### Phase 3 — Live markup (~85 hits)

`project-index.html` (68), `src/core/mvvm-test.html` (20), `articles/` (6), `server.js` (3).
Real pages a reader can load. Small, visible, verifiable in the browser.

**Gate:** `tests/compliance/no-unimplemented-elements.spec.ts` and
`tests/pages/every-page-loads-without-errors.spec.ts` stay green.

### Phase 4 — Scaffolding (274 hits, 16 files)

`templates/presets/*`. Every project created from this template inherits the dead
vocabulary. Overlaps with #771 (create-wb-starter ships the framework's maintenance
surface).

**Gate:** scaffold a fresh project, load it, audit it — `--dir` supports exactly this.

### Phase 5 — Prose (~560 hits)

Comments and docs across `src/` and `docs/`. Harmless to run, actively misleading to read:
201 of 202 `src/**/*.js` hits are JSDoc examples showing a tag that no longer exists. Cheap,
and worth nothing until phases 2–4 are done.

**Gate:** TAG reaches 0. Flip the audit to a hard failure.

### Not scheduled

**CLASS (35,134), MODULE (5,484), PACKAGE (5,103), DATA (1,881).** Together these are 47,602
of the 48,768 total — **97.6% of all `wb-` strings are deliberate, not debris.** They should
move only on their own decision, with their own reason, never as collateral of the tag
cleanup.

## How to re-run

```bash
node scripts/audit-wb-prefix.mjs
```

```bash
node scripts/audit-wb-prefix.mjs --detail
```

```bash
node scripts/audit-wb-prefix.mjs --files
```

```bash
node scripts/audit-wb-prefix.mjs --dir ../my-site
```

Exit code is 1 while any component tag survives, 0 when none do.
